subject: Request: prompt redaction and audit log export for HIPAA audit
messages:
From: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@beaconhealth.org>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@beaconhealth.org>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: prompt redaction and audit log export for HIPAA audit

Hi Dylan,

We're preparing for a HIPAA-focused vendor review and need a few items from Redwood to close our internal checklist. Can you confirm and provide the following by COB Aug 5?

1) Do you use customer prompts or chat transcripts to train models or improve model weights? If yes, please explain opt-out controls and how we can ensure Beacon's data is excluded.
2) Do you store raw prompts/responses? If so, what retention windows and what PII redaction/pseudonymization is applied automatically?
3) Can you provide a sample audit-export (per-customer) of recent request logs in a delimited format (timestamp, request_id, model, token_count, prompt_redacted, response_redacted) — redacted as necessary for privacy but showing the schema we would receive.
4) Do you have a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement on file with Redwood? Please attach and indicate if there are any exceptions.
5) Please point us to SOC 2 evidence or provide a SOC 2 summary that references logging and data handling practices.

We may need a short attestation letter for our compliance team that summarises: you do not train on customer content without explicit opt-in, per-customer opt-out is enforceable, and a statement of retention & redaction policies.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive for our audit window.

Sara Mitchell
Data Protection Officer
Beacon Health

Attachments: none

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@beaconhealth.org>

Sara — thanks for the clear list.
Quick acknowledgement: we can provide a redacted sample export and the SOC 2 summary. I'll loop in Security (Evelyn) and Privacy (Neha) to prepare the attestation and the per-customer export sample.

We may need to coordinate on the exact scope (date range / APIs used) for the export — are you looking for the last 30 days?

I’ll aim to get a preliminary zip (schema + sample rows) and the attestation draft to you by Aug 2, and final by Aug 5.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415 555 0123

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@beaconhealth.org>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: prompt redaction and audit log export for HIPAA audit

Hi Sara — Evelyn from Security at Redwood. Below is a concise technical response and attached artifacts. See attachments: prompt_handling_summary.pdf (policy + flow), beacon_audit_export_sample.tsv (synthetic rows), soc2-summary-2026.pdf, hipaa_ba_executed.pdf. Also adding a side-by-side redaction sample (redaction_side_by_side_sample.txt).

Summary answers:
- Training on customer content: Redwood does not use customer prompts, messages, or chat transcripts to train our public model weights by default. Customers can opt in if they want help improving open models; opt-in is explicit and recorded per-account. For customers on our Hosted API, the default setting is "no training on customer data."

- Opt-out controls and enforcement: We offer a per-account training exclusion toggle in the Console and via API (accounts/{account_id}/settings). Once exclusion is enabled, a policy-layer prevents those request payloads from entering any downstream training pipelines. Enforcement is logged and audit trails are kept for the policy change.

- Storage and retention: We persist request logs for operational troubleshooting and billing. Default retention is 90 days for raw request text, after which raw text is programmatically purged. Metadata (timestamps, request_id, model, token counts, hashes) is retained for 5 years for audit purposes.

- Redaction and PII handling: We apply an automatic PII detection and redaction step at ingest. Detected PII tokens are replaced with token-type markers (e.g., <EMAIL_REDACTED>, <SSN_REDACTED>). For customers with higher privacy needs we offer configurable redaction rules and an additional pseudonymization layer that replaces detected entities with stable pseudonyms when required.

- Audit export schema: the attached TSV sample shows the fields we can export: timestamp | request_id | model | user_id | token_count | prompt_redacted | response_redacted | prompt_hash | redaction_level. We supply both redacted text and a reversible-hash of the original (hash only, salted per-customer) so Beacon can verify integrity without Redwood exposing raw content. The sample uses synthetic data and demonstrates the redaction markers.

- HIPAA BA: We have an executed BAA template (attached). Please confirm if Beacon requires a custom amendment — our legal team can review.

- SOC 2: Attached summary highlights controls around logging, change management, and access. Full report can be shared under NDA / secure portal.

Next steps:
1) Confirm date range and which APIs (chat vs completions vs embeddings) you want in the export.
2) If you need a fully redacted side-by-side sample with real Beacon-like data, provide a short example (we can synthesize to match format).
3) We can provide a signed attestation letter. I’ve included a short technical attestation draft in the attachments.

If you want a live walkthrough of the export generation, we can schedule a 30-min session — happy to demo the Console export flow.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: prompt_handling_summary.pdf (8 pages), beacon_audit_export_sample.tsv (sample), soc2-summary-2026.pdf, hipaa_ba_executed.pdf, redaction_side_by_side_sample.txt

From: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@beaconhealth.org>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@beaconhealth.org>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: prompt redaction and audit log export for HIPAA audit

Evelyn — thanks for the prompt and detailed response and for the attachments. A few follow-ups: 

- The sample TSV looks good. For our audit we need a side-by-side example where the original (synthetic) prompt and the redacted prompt are shown, indicating which tokens were redacted and why. Your redaction_side_by_side_sample.txt covers this but can you include an example that mirrors Beacon's typical chat payloads (username + freeform patient notes)?
- Regarding retention: Please provide the exact retention policy text we can include in our vendor risk register (we need the retention durations and the purge mechanism described).
- For the BAA: Beacon requires a clause that covers subcontractor handling (i.e., if Redwood uses downstream providers for logs storage). Is that covered in your attached version? If not, please flag where we'd need an amendment.

Also, can you provide the attestation as a signed PDF (company letterhead) stating: "Redwood Inference attests that it will not use Beacon Health customer content to train model weights without Beacon's explicit opt-in, and that per-account opt-out is enforced and auditable."

If possible, we’d like the signed attestation and the more tailored redaction example by COB Aug 5.

Thanks,
Sara

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Best,
Dylan
